student_monthly_pass.name: tanuló bérlet
eligibility: Usually requires valid Hungarian or accepted student identification and proof of active student status.
Confirm current eligibility, fare zones, and discount categories with DKV before purchase.
purchase_and_use: Buy at an authorized DKV point or through the official DKV/mobile ticket service if the student pass is available for your status.
Use the MÁV app only for railway journeys; use DKV's official app or ticket channels for Debrecen local transport.
Select the correct validity month and keep the pass or app ticket available for inspection.
A student monthly pass is generally for the calendar month and may have an extended validity-to-the-5th rule according to DKV ticket conditions; verify the exact dates at purchase.
validation: Paper single tickets must be time-validated immediately after boarding on the tram, bus, or trolleybus.
Activate or validate mobile tickets exactly according to the app's shown rules before the journey.
A pass or digital ticket must remain readable and available for an inspector.
Carry accepted student ID and proof of eligibility together with a student pass.
Do not photograph or reuse someone else's pass. Keep the device charged and online where activation requires it.
avoid_fines: Never board with an expired, wrong-fare, or unvalidated ticket.
Validate a paper ticket in the yellow/red machine for each required trip.
Do not assume a tram or bus platform ticket validates the vehicle journey.
If fined, read the notice for the protest deadline and official payment or appeal instructions.
Check diversions and route changes in the DKV app before departure.

apps.dkv_app: Use official DKV ticketing and timetable services for Debrecen trams, buses, trolleybuses, airport buses, route planning, and live schedules.
apps.mav_app: Use MÁV for Hungarian rail services such as trains to/from Debrecen. A MÁV passenger ticket or student rail fare does not replace a DKV local transport ticket.
apps.tip: Save both routes and tickets before entering weak-network areas, and verify transfer stops rather than relying only on approximate walking estimates.

hungarian_admin_glossary.action: Do not ignore it. Read the deadline and list of missing items, upload or deliver exactly what is requested, and retain proof of submission.
Treat the stated date and time as the final submission or appearance deadline. Account for portal, appointment, and postal delays.
Verify whether the email concerns application, decision, extension, collection, or expiry. Follow the portal instructions and keep copies of permits and receipts.
Obtain the official certificate from Neptun or the university administration. Check its issue date and validity; many applications require a current certificate.
Open the Neptun Finances tab or official payment request, verify the amount and deadline, pay through the accepted method, and save the receipt.
Register through Neptun before the stated deadline, confirm the exam venue and cancellation rules, and deregister if you cannot attend where cancellation is allowed.

hungarian_admin_glossary.meaning: Proof or registration of a Hungarian address
hungarian_admin_glossary.action: Prepare the official address-registration document or address card. Check whether the landlord or accommodation owner must also provide a statement.
Read the decision for the appeal authority and short statutory deadline. Submit the formal appeal with grounds and supporting documents; do not assume a missing appeal is acceptable.
Check whether the university's active, interrupted, or finished status is listed correctly in Neptun and resolve discrepancies promptly.
Ask whether an original, certified copy, digital copy, or stamped university form is required.

residence_permit_extension.authority: National Directorate-General for Aliens Policing (OIF) through Enter Hungary
rules: Do not wait until the permit expires. For an initial application or extension, follow the OIF/Enter Hungary deadline instructions and generally file or start the extension process at least 30 days before expiry.
Use the Enter Hungary portal to identify the correct purpose, upload documents, book or complete the appointment, and track the application.
Reply promptly to a hiánypótlás request and follow the listed deadline.
documents: Valid passport and, if applicable, copies of the current residence permit.
Active student status certificate (hallgatói jogviszony igazolás), normally current and issued close to the application date.
Accommodation contract and/or lakcímbejelentő or proof of registered Hungarian address.
Proof of sufficient funds: bank statements or the Stipendium Hungaricum scholarship award/letter and other official sponsorship evidence.
Health-insurance or private-insurance proof as applicable.
Completed application forms, photos, and fee or application receipts when required.
steps: Confirm the permit expiry date and check it against the 30-day recommended filing window.
Log in to Enter Hungary and select the residence-permit extension for studies.
Prepare clear copies of the passport, permit, address proof, finances, insurance, and current student certificate.
Complete and submit the application and pay or arrange fees as instructed.
Record any appointment and attend with originals plus copies.
Save the receipt and monitor further communications for biographic data, collection, or missing-document requests.

taj_card_application.authority: NEAK / National Health Insurance Fund of Hungary
taj_card_application.eligibility_note: Coverage depends on the student's status, residence permit, EEA/EU rules, scholarship conditions, insurance agreement, and employment. Confirm the applicable category before applying.
documents: Valid passport or accepted identity document.
Address card or official proof of address/lakcím.
Residence permit card and a copy of both sides for third-country students.
Student status certificate issued by the university and current within the application period.
Stipendium Hungaricum award letter or other scholarship proof if applicable.
Completed NEAK TAJ application form, as required.
steps: Determine whether you need to submit a new TAJ application, renewal, or employer-based application.
Download or obtain the current NEAK form and gather originals plus copies.
Where required, arrange a health-insurance contribution agreement and confirm the exact contribution amount.
Submit in person at the NEAK/appropriate customer office and receive the submission acknowledgment.
Wait for the TAJ number/card process to complete; keep the confirmation and follow collection or postal instructions.
Verify the TAJ number is active before relying on public-health coverage and renew or update it after residence-permit changes.
taj_card_application.important: Rules and required forms can change. Check University of Debrecen's international-administration and NEAK pages immediately before applying.

tax_id_application.purpose: Needed for taxable student work, scholarship payments, or tax procedures when NAV has not automatically issued an adóazonosító jel.
documents: Hungarian address card or acceptable proof of address.
Residence-permit or registration documents where applicable.
Completed NAV T34 form for a first tax-ID application.
Scholarship or employer information if requested.
steps: Ask the employer or scholarship administrator whether you already have a Hungarian tax ID.
If not, obtain the current NAV T34 form and fill in the Hungarian address and identity details accurately.
Submit in person at a NAV office or by the currently accepted postal/e-filing method.
Keep the acknowledgment and any tax-card or interim certificate.
Give the tax ID to the employer or payer through the required payroll or tax declaration process.
Update NAV if your address or taxpayer details change.
Sign in to Neptun and confirm that the displayed academic year, semester, name, training, and faculty are correct.
Open Administration > My semesters or the corresponding semester-status menu and activate/register for the semester within the official registration period.
Read the semester's registration, subject, and exam instructions in Messages and official faculty notices.
Register for required and elective subjects in Subjects and then add the correct course groups or timetables.
Check timetable overlaps, prerequisites, subject codes, credit totals, and course capacity.
Register for exams only in the exam calendar, observing the registration/cancellation deadline and cancellation penalties.
Open the Finances tab and check tuition, dormitory, service, scholarship, and payment obligations.
Resolve befizetési kötelezettség items and save payment receipts.
Before the period closes, recheck semester status, registered subjects, course groups, exams, messages, and timetable.
exam_rules: An exam registration is only valid if Neptun shows the student as registered.
Cancel within the permitted Neptun window if you cannot attend, where cancellation is allowed.
The faculty may apply a different cancellation or re-registration deadline; follow the formal course/exam notice.
A passed exam and an exam penalty or unsuccessful attempt can have different retake rules.

emergency_numbers.clinical_center_emergency_care: Use 112 for life-threatening emergencies; the Clinical Center emergency department is at 4032 Debrecen, Nagyerdei körút 98.
emergency_numbers.university_campus_security: Use the campus reception or security desk listed for the specific building for non-emergency incidents. Call 112 for immediate danger. The University of Debrecen's general switchboard is not a substitute for 112.
emergency_numbers.pharmacy_on_duty: Ask for the ügyeletes gyógyszertár. Use a current pharmacy-duty listing or call local directory information before traveling because the on-duty address and hours rotate.
